Rebased and done. **PR #2076** is open for your review.

To be clear about the two images I sent: they're from a **scratch harness**, not the deployed dashboard — a throwaway page importing the three shipped modules (`read/usage`, `derive/tasks-machine`, `render/machine-view`) with the real page stylesheet, fed this repo's own `tasks-usage.GENERATED.json`. Real render path, real data; the harness itself is deliberately not in the diff.

**What landed** — `derive/tasks-machine.mjs` (pure derivation, repo + fleet) and `render/machine-view.mjs` (one renderer for both pages), wired into the two views with a section each, plus 26 tests and doc updates.

**The rebase mattered twice.** The first one is why there's a PR at all: earlier this session I converged this item as `action` because `.claudinite/local/tasks-usage.GENERATED.json` wasn't on `main` yet. By the time you said retry, #2064 had landed it. The second, onto `ab520dc`, picked up #2068's `shared-code` → `public` move — I checked both sides survived rather than trusting the clean exit: `view-repo.mjs` now imports `claudinite-tasks/public/dormancy.mjs` and my added imports are intact. Nothing new here reaches into the tasks pack.

**Looking at the render caught a real bug that no test would have.** The run chart was drawing a floor line — "the machinery ran zero times" — on four days that carry the item half and no run figure. The file's two halves fold on separate watermarks, so each series now answers for its own recorded-ness. That's in the diff with two tests pinning it.

**Gate:** suite 3723/3723, `check_the_world` exit 0 with zero blocking. See-it-fail run on both suites — weakening `sum` to return `0` reddened the four unknown-is-not-zero cases, collapsing the per-half flag reddened the two new ones.

Two things need you:

1. **#1874's status is stuck and I left it that way.** `converge-item.mjs` refuses the item — this session released it in the earlier convergence, so it no longer holds it — and hand-fabricating that transition is exactly what the refusal prevents. It still wears `task:status:needs-human-action` while the work is finished. Don't clear the status, that re-queues M2; it wants `task:status:needs-human-approval` with `Ends-when: #2076 closed`. I commented this on the item.
2. **#2077** asks whether janitor repairs and leash reclaims are worth counters. The brief asked for them "where the file records them" — it doesn't, so the panel names both as gaps and I added no counter.

Also filed **#2078**, unrelated: the preferences pack's session-start suite reads ambient `CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ATTENDED`, so it's six-red in every unattended session and green in CI. It cost me a diagnostic cycle here; I left it out of this PR as a different pack.

- authoring-agent-docs: How to write instruction files coding agents follow reliably. Use before writing or editing any Claude instruction doc — a project CLAUDE.md, a convention doc, a routine spec.
- bug-investigation: Method for investigating a bug and pinning down its root cause. Use when investigating a bug report, when a fix didn't hold or a bug recurs, or when a report doesn't reproduce against main.
